battle.name: 阿曼統一戰爭
battle.theater: 阿曼北部傑貝爾阿赫達爾山區
battle.brief: 阿曼統一戰爭於一九五四年起在阿曼內陸展開，內戰一方由伊瑪目穆罕默德領導，另一方為蘇丹賽義德，爭奪全國統治權，北部山區成為主要戰場。列表所附裝備是英國海軍鐵甲艦（Ironclad，1862年），其型號早於本衝突，並非宣稱該艦參戰。

kit.name: 鐵甲艦
kit.history: 鐵甲艦是十九世紀英國海軍以鐵甲防護重炮平台、以蒸汽動力航行的裝甲戰艦，屬當時主力艦隊的海上火力核心。

countries: 這裡所稱的「阿曼統一戰爭」，指1954年6月爆發、至1959年8月結束的伊馬姆戰爭，並非1963年另起的佐法爾叛亂。交戰主體一方是控制馬斯喀特、索哈爾海岸與若干島嶼的馬斯喀特與阿曼蘇丹政府，另一方是由前伊馬姆加利卜・本・阿里率領、據於內陸山區的阿曼伊馬姆政權。英國以武器、軍事顧問、皇家陸軍特種部隊、皇家砲兵與空軍支援政府；沙烏地阿拉伯和埃及則向伊馬姆方面提供庇護、補給或外部通道。戰區沿Buraimi、Ibri、Wadi Batin、Nizwa、Rustaq至Jebel Akhdar展開，爭奪的不是一條固定前線，而是城鎮、道路、峽谷和山地方圓的控制權。
countriesEn: The term Oman War of Unification used here denotes the Imamate War that began in June 1954 and ended in August 1959, not the separate Dhofar rebellion that began in 1963. One principal belligerent was the government of the Sultanate of Muscat and Oman, which controlled Muscat, the Sohar coast, and several islands; the other was the Omani Imamate under former Imam Ghaleb bin Ali, based in the interior mountains. Britain supported the government with weapons, military advisers, British Army special forces, Royal Artillery, and the Royal Air Force; Saudi Arabia and Egypt provided the Imamate side with shelter, supplies, or external access. The theatre extended from Buraimi, Ibri, and Wadi Batin through Nizwa and Rustaq to Jebel Akhdar. The issue was not a fixed front line but control of towns, roads, wadis, and mountain districts.
people: 蘇丹賽義德・本・泰穆爾是政府的最高政治與軍事權威，他接受英國援助，把沿海的稅收、交通線與阿曼內陸的伊馬姆勢力對抗整合在同一套指揮體系下。前伊馬姆加利卜・本・阿里則是叛軍的政治與軍事核心，他以伊馬姆身分調動內陸武裝，並從沙烏地阿拉伯取得外部支援。英國高級專員傑拉德・坦普勒於1955至1956年在阿曼協調軍援，但並非前線總指揮；SAS指揮官大衛・斯特林則參與特種作戰、部隊訓練及政府防衛力量的整編。卡布斯・本・賽義德自1956年出任國防與內政部長，逐步主持政府一方的軍務，並在1959年最後攻勢中扮演核心角色。叛軍方面則由伊馬姆透過地方指揮員與分散的武裝網路下達命令，協調較鬆散，通訊與補給因此更易受到打擊。
peopleEn: Sultan Said bin Taymur was the government’s supreme political and military authority. He accepted British assistance and sought to bring the coastal revenues, communications routes, and the struggle against the Imamate in the interior under one command system. Former Imam Ghaleb bin Ali was the political and military core of the insurgents, mobilizing interior armed groups under his Imamate title and obtaining external support from Saudi Arabia. British High Commissioner Gerald Templer coordinated assistance in Oman from 1955 to 1956, although he was not the frontline commander; SAS commander David Stirling participated in special operations, troop training, and the organization of the government’s defensive forces. Qaboos bin Said became Minister of Defence and Interior in 1956, progressively directed government military affairs, and played a central role in the final offensive of 1959. On the rebel side, the Imam issued orders through local commanders and a dispersed armed network, making the structure less centralized and its communications and supply more vulnerable to attack.
kits: 政府步兵的主要栓動步槍是李－恩菲爾德四型，班制火力通常由架於步槍上的Bren輕機槍提供，較重要的固定陣地則配置Vickers中型機槍；英製2英寸迫擊炮與25磅野戰炮構成連、排支援火力。英方後期把Centurion主力戰坦克及Saladin六輪裝甲車投入內陸，Land Rover Series I負責聯絡與偵察，Chevrolet CMP卡車和同類載重車把海岸基地的糧食、飲水、燃油、輪胎及備件運往Sohar與內陸集結區。Avro Anson和de Havilland Dove等英國輕型機執行偵察、聯絡及砲兵校射。伊馬姆軍可見的步槍包括Mauser 98k、Martini-Henry及李－恩菲爾德式，也使用繳獲的Sten Mk II、Bren、Vickers和2英寸迫擊炮。英軍主要使用.303子彈，Sten使用9毫米彈，25磅炮施放87.6磅高爆彈，另有迫擊炮炸彈。這些型號至遲在1954年均已列裝，但油料、輪胎、備件與高爆彈的供應速度，決定了裝甲車與遠程火力能持續作戰多久。
kitsEn: The government’s infantry relied principally on the Lee-Enfield No. 4 rifle, with section fire normally supplied by the tripod-mounted Bren light machine gun and important fixed positions defended by Vickers medium machine guns. British 2-inch mortars and 25-pounder field guns provided company and battalion support. In the later phase, Britain committed Centurion main battle tanks and Saladin six-wheeled armoured cars to the interior, while Land Rover Series I vehicles handled liaison and reconnaissance and Chevrolet CMP and comparable trucks carried food, water, fuel, tyres, and spare parts from coastal bases to assembly areas around Sohar and the interior. British light aircraft such as the Avro Anson and de Havilland Dove performed reconnaissance, liaison, and artillery observation. Insurgent weapons included Mauser 98k, Martini-Henry, and Lee-Enfield rifles, together with captured Sten Mk II, Bren, and Vickers weapons and 2-inch mortars. British forces principally used .303 ammunition, the Sten used 9 mm ammunition, and the 25-pounder fired the 87.6-pound high-explosive shell alongside mortar bombs. All these types had entered service by 1954 at the latest, but the delivery rates of fuel, tyres, spare parts, and high-explosive ammunition determined how long armour and long-range fire could remain in contact.
tactics: 政府初期以沿海為補給基地，靠公路車隊把兵力送入Buraimi、Ibri與Wadi Batin，並用偵察機、地面搜索隊和可靠的道路情報尋找叛軍集結處。SAS小組適合執行夜間偵察、破壞通訊與短暫襲擊，卻不能代替常規步兵長期佔據峽谷；英方因此把25磅炮配置在道路和谷口可觀察的位置，以空軍校射及地面前觀引導火力。伊馬姆軍採取游擊與野戰混合方式，武裝小組多在夜間移動，白天分散於岩地、椰林與預築掩體，襲擊政府巡邏隊、孤立哨所及補給車列，再於追兵接近前轉移。占據Jebel Akhdar後，部分據點也以交叉射界和岩石陣位固守。1959年的最後階段，政府先控制Wadi Batin出口、Buraimi至Ibri道路及通往綠山的山口，再派小型特種偵察組進入高地；砲兵攻擊已知陣位，主力則由車隊送至可展開地點，步兵沿脊線推進。叛軍可調動的車輛與重武器有限，山口一旦受堵，孤立據點的彈藥和退路便迅速縮小。
tacticsEn: At first, the government used the coast as its supply base and moved troops by road convoys toward Buraimi, Ibri, and Wadi Batin, while reconnaissance aircraft, ground search parties, and dependable road intelligence located insurgent concentrations. Small SAS teams were well suited to night reconnaissance, communications disruption, and short raids, but they could not replace regular infantry in holding wadis for long. Britain therefore positioned 25-pound guns where roads and valley mouths could be observed, using aerial observation and forward ground controllers to direct fire. The Imamate forces combined guerrilla warfare with conventional operations. Armed groups moved mainly at night and dispersed during the day among rocks, palm groves, and prepared cover, striking government patrols, isolated posts, and supply columns before moving away as pursuit forces approached. After occupying Jebel Akhdar, some units held fortified positions with interlocking fields of fire. In the final phase of 1959, the government first secured the exits of Wadi Batin, the Buraimi-Ibri road, and the passes leading into the Green Mountain. Small special reconnaissance teams then entered the heights, artillery engaged known positions, and motorized columns brought the main force to deployment areas before infantry advanced along the ridges. The insurgents had few vehicles and heavy weapons; once the passes were blocked, isolated positions rapidly lost ammunition and withdrawal routes.
data: 戰役可按幾個階段重建。1953至1954年初，前伊馬姆在英方壓力下接受退出統治的安排，隨即前往沙烏地阿拉伯。1954年6月，加利卜・本・阿里率武裝人員返回阿曼，奪取或包圍內陸若干政府據點；同年下半年，衝突沿Buraimi、Ibri、Wadi Batin和通往Nizwa、Rustaq的山路擴展，政府一度失去多個內陸聯絡點。1955年，英國將顧問、SAS支援、皇家砲兵與航空補給系統化投入，衝突由零散遠程襲擊變成政府軍與叛軍交替攻擊城鎮和山口的持久戰。1956年，卡布斯・本・賽義德進入國防與內政核心，政府防衛部隊獲得較集中訓練與裝備。1957至1958年，Nizwa、Rustaq及Nakhal周邊據點先後易手，政府逐步封住伊馬姆向北部及沿海調動的通道，叛軍則退守Jebel Akhdar。1959年，最後攻勢沿Wadi Batin-Ibri方向及Nizwa側山地展開，砲兵、特種偵察和主力步兵相互配合；至8月，綠山的主要抵抗停止，加利卜・本・阿里投降，殘餘武裝分散。現存資料沒有完整而可信的雙方傷亡總表，各階段流傳數字亦互相矛盾，因此不能把任何單一數字當作戰役的確定損失。
dataEn: The campaign can be reconstructed in several phases. From 1953 to early 1954, the former Imam accepted arrangements to withdraw from power under British pressure and then went to Saudi Arabia. In June 1954, Ghaleb bin Ali returned to Oman with armed followers, seizing or surrounding several government posts in the interior; during the second half of that year, fighting expanded along Buraimi, Ibri, Wadi Batin, and the routes toward Nizwa and Rustaq, and the government temporarily lost several interior communications points. In 1955, Britain systematized the deployment of advisers, SAS support, Royal Artillery, and aerial resupply, changing the conflict from scattered long-range raids into a sustained struggle over towns and mountain passes fought through alternating government and insurgent attacks. In 1956, Qaboos bin Said moved into the core of defence and interior affairs, and the government’s defensive forces received more centralized training and equipment. From 1957 to 1958, positions around Nizwa, Rustaq, and Nakhal changed hands, while the government progressively sealed the Imam’s routes north and toward the coast, forcing the insurgents back toward Jebel Akhdar. In 1959, the final offensive advanced along the Wadi Batin-Ibri axis and through the highlands on the Nizwa side, combining artillery, special reconnaissance, and infantry. By August, organized resistance on the Green Mountain had ceased, Ghaleb bin Ali surrendered, and the remaining armed groups dispersed. The surviving records do not contain a complete and reliable aggregate casualty figure for either side, and the circulating estimates conflict, so no single number can be treated as a verified loss.
cause: 長期根源是1932年形成的雙重權力結構：蘇丹在國際上代表馬斯喀特與沿海行政，伊馬姆則在內陸保有宗教與部族權威。英國希望阿曼只存在一個能履行條約、維持道路與行政命令的政府，於是推動前伊馬姆放棄獨立統治；這項安排削弱了伊馬姆的正當性，也把他推向沙烏地阿拉伯。蘇丹一方則面臨具體難題：內陸據點距離海岸遠、道路有限，而英國援助雖能提供火砲與航空，卻不能自動替政府取得山地方圓的效忠。沙烏地阿拉伯與埃及把伊馬姆視為對抗英國影響及沿海蘇丹權力的支點，因而提供武器、資金或穿越邊境的便利。直接導火線是加利卜・本・阿里於1954年6月帶武裝返回並奪據；此後這場衝突既是蘇丹集權與伊馬姆復權的對抗，也被捲入英國與阿拉伯國家在海灣地區的競爭，但作戰核心始終是能掌握本地地形、運輸和部族武裝的一方。
causeEn: The underlying cause was the dual structure of authority formed in 1932: the Sultan internationally represented Muscat and coastal administration, while the Imam retained religious and tribal authority in the interior. Britain wanted Oman to possess a single government capable of honoring treaties and maintaining roads and administrative orders, and therefore pressed the former Imam to abandon separate rule. That settlement undermined the Imamate’s legitimacy and pushed Ghaleb toward Saudi Arabia. The Sultan’s government faced a concrete problem: interior positions were far from the coast, the road network was limited, and although British assistance supplied artillery and aircraft, it could not automatically secure local allegiance across the mountains. Saudi Arabia and Egypt treated the Imam as a useful counterweight to British influence and the coastal Sultan’s authority, and accordingly supplied arms, money, or convenient access across the frontier. The immediate trigger was Ghaleb bin Ali’s armed return in June 1954 and seizure of positions. The resulting struggle was both a contest between Sultanic centralization and restoration of the Imamate and part of the wider British-Arab competition in the Gulf, but control of local terrain, transport, and tribal armed networks remained central to the actual fighting.
impact: 1959年後，政府不再只是馬斯喀特與沿海的行政中心，而能以常設軍事單位控制通往Nizwa、Rustaq和Jebel Akhdar的道路與據點；改編後的政府防衛部隊成為後來阿曼蘇丹武裝力量的核心。戰役也迫使政府建立更密集的後勤體系，在Sohar及其他沿海基地維持車隊、燃料、武器維修和醫療轉運，並修築道路、機場、通訊與觀察哨，使砲兵與航空兵能與內陸地面部隊保持聯絡。英國顧問和SAS的作用在此役中高度突出，卡布斯・本・賽義德主持的改革則逐步增加阿曼軍官自行指揮的比例，政治權力與軍隊指揮因而更集中於蘇丹政府。實戰也顯示，飛機與重炮能壓縮游擊隊的活動空間卻不能代替可靠的地面情報；若道路情報、嚮導和補給不足，再強的火力也可能找不到確定的射擊位置。這場勝利解決了政府對內陸的實際控制，卻沒有一舉解決阿曼與沙烏地阿拉伯之間的全部邊界爭議。
impactEn: After 1959, the government was no longer merely an administrative centre on the coast; it could maintain permanent military units along the roads and positions leading to Nizwa, Rustaq, and Jebel Akhdar. The reorganized government defensive force became the core of the later Sultan of Oman’s Armed Forces. The campaign also compelled the government to create a denser logistics system, maintaining vehicle columns, fuel, weapons maintenance, and medical evacuation from Sohar and other coastal bases, while building roads, airfields, communications, and observation posts that allowed artillery and aircraft to remain connected with inland forces. British advisers and the SAS were prominent during the war, while the reforms led by Qaboos bin Said increased the share of command entrusted to Omani officers, concentrating political authority and military direction in the Sultan’s government. Combat experience also showed that aircraft and heavy artillery could compress guerrilla movement but could not replace reliable ground intelligence; without road information, guides, and supply, even powerful firepower might have no firm target. The victory established effective government control of the interior but did not settle every border dispute between Oman and Saudi Arabia.
result: 1959年8月，Jebel Akhdar的主要陣地在外來通道被封、砲兵持續壓制和步兵沿高地推進的共同作用下失去連絡，加利卜・本・阿里放棄抵抗並向政府投降。其後伊馬姆的指揮網迅速瓦解，山上堡壘由政府軍接收，零散武裝有的投降、有的解散或逃入更偏僻山地；伊馬姆本人隨後被送往沙烏地阿拉伯，從此失去在阿曼重新集結武裝的能力。蘇丹賽義德・本・泰穆爾的權力至此實際延伸至海岸與內陸，阿曼伊馬姆政權在國內政治與軍事上告終。這是一場歷時五年、由游擊戰、據點爭奪和縱深後勤共同構成的戰役，而不是一次單一會戰；其結果是政府取得內陸控制權，並留下日後擴張為常備軍的部隊骨架。需要保留的界線是，內部權力集中並不等於全部對外邊界問題已經解決。
resultEn: In August 1959, the principal positions on Jebel Akhdar lost contact as their external routes were sealed, artillery fire continued, and infantry advanced across the highlands. Ghaleb bin Ali abandoned resistance and surrendered to the government. The Imam’s command network then disintegrated rapidly; government troops occupied the mountain fortifications, and the scattered fighters either surrendered, dispersed, or withdrew into more remote areas. Ghaleb was subsequently sent to Saudi Arabia and from then on was unable to reconstitute an armed force in Oman. Sultan Said bin Taymur’s authority thereby extended in practice from the coast into the interior, and the Omani Imamate ended as a domestic political and military institution. This was a five-year campaign made up of guerrilla warfare, struggles for fortified positions, and sustained logistics rather than a single decisive battle. Its result was government control of the interior and a military nucleus that could later develop into a standing army. The necessary qualification is that internal concentration of authority did not mean that every external border dispute had been resolved.
